interface.title: Cutout Image List Tool for DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys and More
interface.field: Observational astronomy (galaxy target selection and visual inspection)
interface.stage_of_work: Target vetting and selection: looking at candidates by eye before follow-up such as spectroscopy
interface.what_it_is_for: Paste a table of sky positions (RA/Dec), see a grid of image cutouts from a chosen survey (Legacy Surveys, SDSS, DSS, WISE, GALEX, HSC, DES and others), click cutouts to flag them, and write the flags back into the table as a 'marked' column.

data.note: The page comes with a list of 15 SAGA satellite candidates (NGC6181b–k, NGC5602b–f) in a SAGA_SAT/RA/DEC table. I also typed my own lists (comma-separated and tab-separated, with and without a 'marked' column, for M101, NGC4565, M87 and NGC891). Cutouts are fetched live from the public survey servers, and most layers loaded. Tiles load one by one, and some show their alt text for a few seconds first or fail to load. HSC DR3 tiles came back blank, most likely because these fields are outside its footprint.

features.name: Pasted-table to thumbnail grid
features.general: Parse a pasted text table with position columns and show one image tile per row, with the row's fields as the tile tooltip and a link to the source's own viewer
features.specific: The textarea is parsed as a space/tab/comma table; each row becomes a cutout tile titled 'SAGA_SAT = … RA = … DEC = …' and linked to the survey's own viewer. Input with fewer than 2 columns shows 'Error! Please make sure the first line is header…'; a header without ra/dec (e.g. 'foo,bar') gives no error and draws a broken tile. The grid redraws on every edit, and typing key by key leaves repeated tiles until one more edit.
steps: paste or type a table, e.g. with a header row naming ra and dec
grid re-renders as the text changes (make one more edit if repeated tiles appear)
hover a tile to read its row values
a single-column input shows the header error; a header without ra/dec draws a broken tile instead

screens_never_reached: External viewers linked from each thumbnail (legacysurvey.org/viewer, skyserver.sdss.org navi): off-limits hosts, so not opened
Credits/issue links (legacysurvey.org acknowledgment, SDSS, STScI DSS form, GitHub issues): external
not_done: Copying the marked table to a file or the clipboard: the tool has no export button. The table only exists as text in the textarea for the user to copy, and I did not test copying.

Getting a clean grid for a typed custom list in my run: the browser tool types key by key, and each keystroke triggers a render that adds tiles. A 3–4 row list ended up as 15+ tiles, including partly typed rows like 'ID = NGC8' (screens/029.webp, screens/033.webp, screens/034.webp). Changing side length or layer kept these stale tiles (screens/036.webp). The replay found that one more edit after typing restores the correct grid (check/screens/015.webp).
Opening a target in the survey's own viewer from its tile link: the hosts were off-limits, so this step was not done.
Did not try every layer (DES DR1, HSC DR2, unWISE NEO7 dust, Halpha, SFD, VLASS, SDSS reprocessed, DSS IR, the single-band DR10/DR9 layers). I tried 9 of 23.
Stale-tile race: after switching from GALEX to DR10 grz, one slot kept the GALEX image (screens/021.webp).

Layer anomalies seen in the replay: the first SDSS view showed the same images as Legacy (check/screens/004.webp, while the SDSS view loaded via ?layer= looked different), and unWISE showed the same images as GALEX (check/screens/009.webp).
Many tiles failed to load in some views (e.g. unWISE Model, screens/046.webp; after the ArrowUp change, screens/047.webp), so those views are weak evidence.
Headerless tables were not tried; the run used only tables with a header row.
Uploading a file: the interface has no upload control, and there were no test files.
